newsitem.title: USA: Cardiovascular, AVECOR in marketing pact.
newsitem.headline: Cardiovascular, AVECOR in marketing pact.

text.p: Cardiovascular Diagnostics Inc said Tuesday it has signed a distribution pact with AVECOR Cardiovascular Inc.

Under the pact AVECOR, a supplier of cardiosurgical products, will distribute Cardiovascular's Thrombolytic Assessment System analyzer and certain test cards in the United States and Canada, Cardiovascular said. Hospitals use the products to monitor anticoagulants in surgical and critical care areas.
Cardiovascular Diagnostics develops, makes and markets systems designed to deliver blood test results at the point-of-care.
The company said it expects to have Food and Drug Administration clearance on an additional 19 tests by 1998.
